FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "http*"  AND user_agent.original is not null AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
| LIMIT 10000
| STATS COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id)
| RENAME `COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id)` AS `Distinct Connections`
| KEEP `Distinct Connections`

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "http*"  AND user_agent.original is not null AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
| LIMIT 10000
| STATS COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id)
| RENAME `COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id)` AS `Distinct Connections`
| KEEP `Distinct Connections`

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "http_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `HTTP Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "HTTP Agg Logs Available", "No HTTP Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `HTTP Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "http_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `HTTP Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "HTTP Agg Logs Available", "No HTTP Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `HTTP Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "http*" AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL AND user_agent.original is not null
| LIMIT 10000
| STATS VALUES(http.response.body.bytes) by source.ip, destination.ip, event.id
| STATS AVG(`VALUES(http.response.body.bytes)`)
| EVAL `Average Body Length` = ROUND(`AVG(``VALUES(http.response.body.bytes)``)`)
| KEEP `Average Body Length`

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "http*" AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL AND dest_host is not null AND user_agent.original IS NOT NULL
| LIMIT 10000
| STATS VALUES(dest_host) by source.ip, destination.ip, event.id 
| STATS COUNT() by `VALUES(dest_host)` 
| RENAME `VALUES(dest_host)` as `URL Domain`, `COUNT()` as Count
| SORT Count desc
| LIMIT 20
| KEEP `URL Domain`, Count

FROM logs-corelight.http*
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "http*"
  AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND dest_host IS NOT NULL

  AND user_agent.original IS NOT NULL
| STATS

    VALUES(http.response.status_code),
    VALUES(http.response.status_name)

| STATS Count = COUNT()

| RENAME

    `VALUES(http.response.status_name)` AS `Vendor Action`
| SORT Count DESC
| KEEP `URL Domain`, `Status`, `Vendor Action`, Count
